response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong software engineering experience (18+ years), polyglot programming skills, and entrepreneurial initiative with GISCollective, aligning well with the technical breadth required. However, his lack of direct AI/cloud specialization, no advanced degrees (Master's/PhD), and limited evidence of AI product/platform development reduces his fit for this Director-level AI Strategy role. His recent AI-agent infrastructure work at re:cinq is promising but not yet demonstrated at scale.
strengths: 18+ years of software engineering across diverse domains (web, mobile, embedded, AI-agent tools)
Entrepreneurial experience founding and scaling GISCollective, showing product vision and execution
Strong polyglot skills (TypeScript, D, Node.js, Swift) and focus on testable, high-performance systems
concerns: No advanced degree (Master's/PhD) in AI-related field, which is a preferred qualification
Limited direct AI/cloud platform experience; recent AI work is early-stage and not clearly strategic
Lacks recognized industry expertise in AI (e.g., no publications, patents, or widely adopted AI products)
